title: 2026 Data Breach Investigations Report
denominatorType: analysed incidents and breaches contributed by participating organisations

scenarioPatterns.note: The public report landing page does not expose the exact analysed-case proportion in an extractable table. No value is invented.

scenarioPatterns.pattern: social engineering, phishing and identity compromise
scenarioPatterns.note: Identity and human-channel patterns can order scenario plausibility but do not provide an annual organisation denominator.
The 2026 headline identifies vulnerabilities as a leading initial-access pattern; the exact share is not transcribed without the report table.
No organisation-level annual third-party event rate is provided.
DDoS is not represented as an annual organisation rate in DBIR.

limitations: Case-based denominators are not organisation exposure denominators.
Contributor selection and reporting practices are not a random sample of all organisations.
Headline percentages may describe breaches among analysed cases, not organisations experiencing an event in a year.
Scenario mappings to the QuickRisk five-scenario taxonomy are not one-to-one.
No scenario weight is activated from this source until an explicit table and mapping are transcribed.
